issues.what: Duplicate chapter title: ch1 and ch3 both 'The Double Wedding'; ch4-6 titles lag one chapter (ch5 'The Wrong Coat' is the cholera chapter, ch6 'The Cholera Letter' is the household ending)
Augustine's pug is Bismarck in ch1 but Foots in ch4-6
issues.quote: Her pug, Bismarck, snored on a velvet cushion

issues.what: Augustine's house is Campden Hill Square in ch1 but Queen's Gate in ch5-6
issues.quote: Rain tapped the drawing room windows in Queen's Gate.

issues.what: Three publishers: Mr Pye (ch2), Mr Beadle (ch3), Tibbs and Hall (ch6) all publish Frank Hartley
issues.quote: Mr Tibbs, of Tibbs and Hall, Fleet Street

issues.what: Ellis is Constance's maid in ch4 but Augustine's servant in ch5-6 (answers her door, returns her signet)
issues.quote: It was Constance's maid, Ellis, in a borrowed coat and hat

issues.what: Philippa has lodgings and walks to her aunt's in ch1, but 'comes down' in Augustine's house wearing the housekeeper's mourning in ch5
issues.quote: Philippa came down with ink on her cuff

issues.what: Timeline: ch5 is 'a week before' the wedding, ch6 same day calls it 'Wedding eve'
issues.quote: Wedding eve, though there is no wedding.

issues.what: Philippa is 27 in brief but 'six and twenty'; Augustine appropriates 'Pippa', which ch5 made Constance's alone
Slips: 'my father's brewery sums' (Constance's father), 'her ladyship' for plain Mrs Crewe, 'Aunt's matchmaking' said to the aunt, Constance calls Augustine 'Aunt' in ch4
issues.quote: Only you doing my father's brewery sums

issues.what: Americanism 'Scoot'; 'two husbands and three doctors' contradicts ch2 'Uncle Crewe and two doctors'
issues.quote: I have buried two husbands and outlived three doctors

issues.what: Repeated lingering-touch device (ch2, ch3, ch4 all 'half a second longer'); 'Too quickly' ch1 and ch2; pug 'paddled his feet' ch1 and ch5; nearly every paragraph lists a smell
issues.quote: They lingered half a second too long at the ribbon.

fix: Retitle all six chapters distinctly. Ch1: pug Bismarck->Foots, maid 'Phil'->'Miss Philippa'. Ch2: Pye->Beadle. Ch3: one husband/two doctors, drop 'Scoot'. Ch4: 'Godmama', Ellis as Augustine's housemaid. Ch5: Campden Hill Square, Philippa arrives from lodgings, your father's sums, Madam not ladyship. Ch6: Tibbs as Beadle's partner, 27, Philippa not Pippa from Augustine, not 'wedding eve'.
praise: Genuinely witty original epigrams ('Quick is only frivolous that pays its bills'; 'A divided Cupid melts') and a tender, unpunchlined love story that ends in a warm household with two chipped cups.
